description: Overlay that renders TmPdfAnnotator annotations over the current page: colored text highlights, stamps, freehand ink strokes (SVG), numbered comment markers, and the pending draft. Used internally by TmPdfAnnotator.

parameters.name: ShowResolved
parameters.description: Whether resolved threads should be rendered.

parameters.name: ColorResolver
parameters.description: Resolves the display color of a thread. Falls back to the default palette.

parameters.name: ActiveStroke
parameters.description: Stroke currently being drawn, when any.

parameters.name: DraftColor
parameters.description: Color used for the draft and the active stroke.

parameters.name: OnThreadSelected
parameters.description: Callback invoked when an annotation is selected.
